name: Notion MCP Server (self-hosted)
upstream_status_note: The README says this self-hosted server is no longer actively maintained or supported and points to the publisher's hosted server. The latest release (2.6.1) is dated 2026-10-29.
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C1, C4, C6, C7, C10; partly meets C5, C8, C9; does not meet C2, C3.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The npm record for @notionhq/notion-mcp-server@2.6.1 names the repository `git+ssh://git@github.com/makenotion/notion-mcp-server.git` and carries a provenance attestation (`dist.attestations`).

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub's security-policy page for the repository says "No security policy detected" and offers no private vulnerability reporting; the README names no channel for security reports (searched for: security@, vulnerability, responsible disclosure, report security).

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is not archived, but the README says the project is no longer maintained or supported. Quoted: “server implementation that is no longer actively maintained or supported.”. Latest release 2.6.1 is dated 2026-10-29; the newest commit on `main` is dated 2026-10-29; GitHub reports the last push on 2026-10-29.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: No advisory is published in the repository's advisory list.

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: The exposed tools include writes; the README documents restricting them through the capabilities of the integration token. Quoted: “For example, you can create a read-only integration token by giving only "Read content" access from the "Configuration" tab:”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: The integration token is supplied through an environment variable. Quoted: “"NOTION_TOKEN": "ntn_****"”.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: The README contains no reference to telemetry or usage collection, and the documented function contacts only the service the user configures. Searched `README.md` for: telemetry, usage statistics, usage stats, we collect, data collection, opt-out, posthog.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`package-lock.json`) is committed. No Dependabot or Renovate configuration file exists at the paths listed in the methodology.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: The README carries a general caution about exposing workspace data to language models; it does not name prompt injection or untrusted content. Quoted: “there is a non-zero risk to workspace data by exposing it to LLMs”.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk ^1.32.2. Lower-bound version 1.32.2 of @modelcontextprotocol/sdk (npm) was published on 2026-10-23, within the 12 months before 2026-11-14.
